note: Текущая версия честно использует широкие фотографии и подготовленные viewpoints. Плавное frame-scrubbing включается после добавления согласованных AI-кадров; настоящая 360°-панорама не имитируется.

capture.loading: center first, then ±1, ±2; remaining frames on idle

generationPrompt.base: Preserve the kitchen exactly: identical layout, cabinet count, fronts, colors, countertop, hardware, appliances, lighting, architecture and proportions. Photorealistic interior photography. Do not add, remove or redesign objects.
generationPrompt.perFrame: Rotate only the virtual camera to yaw {angle} degrees around the fixed viewpoint. Keep camera height, lens, exposure and all geometry unchanged. Maintain strict cross-frame consistency.
